title: One place the whole team actually writes in.
body: Docs, projects, decisions and the notes hanging off them. Nothing lives in four tools and three inboxes any more.

title: Answers that show their working.
body: Ask in plain language. Margin answers from your own pages and hands you the line it read.

title: Every note, waiting on one board.
body: A note in the margin becomes a card the moment somebody needs it done. Nothing gets typed twice.
